title: Broken Calculator
description: Calculate minimum operations to reach target from startValue using multiply by 2 or subtract 1. We work backwards from target to startValue.
pseudocode:
1. while target > startValue:
2.   if target is even, target /= 2
3.   else target += 1
4. return ops + (startValue - target)

steps.note: Initialize starting state with target 3 and startValue 2.
Target 3 is odd, apply inverse of subtract 1 (add 1).
Target 4 is even, apply inverse of multiply by 2 (divide by 2).
Target is no longer greater than startValue, return total operations (2).
